A '''Miniprobe''' was a type of miniature [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droid]] who were commonly used as companions<ref name="CM">[[Cartel Market|''Star Wars: The Old Republic'' Cartel Market]]</ref> during the [[Old Republic-era]].<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref> They were usually equipped with [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlifts]] and had single dedicated tasks.<ref name="CM" />
